parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of a bucket, typically made of steel wire or rod for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can pivot or rotate around its attachment points on the bucket body to facilitate carrying and pouring.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, made of galvanized steel to resist corrosion and hold liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary container for holding water, sand, or other materials.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed, rigid part that does not move; it supports the contents and connects to the handle.
